purpose: Inventory of existing date semantics and rendering; flags are review prompts, not historical corrections.

flag_definitions.prose_derived_span: The display infers numeric dates and continuation from prose. This does not by itself establish an incorrect historical date.
flag_definitions.person_continues_to_frame: A person entry is drawn solid to the frame end, without a recorded per-person review year. Review the distinction between contributions and reception.
flag_definitions.debate_continues_to_frame: A Debate entry is drawn beyond its last selected year toward the frame end. Review whether the exchange is bounded or continuing.
flag_definitions.normalized_end_after_review: The normalized span end exceeds the review year. This may represent selected later evidence or a parsed decade bound, not a survey of the later period.
flag_definitions.review_precedes_normalized_start: The review year predates the normalized start; inspect the inherited review metadata and its meaning.
flag_definitions.structured_start_differs_from_prose: The explicit span starts at a different year from the first parsed year. This can correctly distinguish antecedents from the main episode.
flag_definitions.present_matched_inside_word: The continuation parser matches present within a larger word, rather than an explicit temporal statement.
